data.name: Pravat
data.gender_notes: Pravat is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pravat is a name of Lord Vishnu, derived from the Sanskrit word 'prava', meaning 'crossing'. This name signifies the one who helps in crossing the difficult stages of life. The name Pravat carries the meaning “Lord of the crossing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Pravat usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the crossing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Pravat is a sacred name of Lord Vishnu, symbolizing wisdom, power, and strength. It is believed to bestow intelligence and courage on the bearer, helping him overcome life's challenges.
data.etymology: Pravat belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the crossing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pravat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
